statement_summary: Program meets SP 800-171 for CUI and FAR 52.204-21 for FCI
Security lead and CMMC Affirming Official designated in writing
Annual risk assessment including supply chain threats
Risk acceptance authority; no DoD product-integrity risk accepted above Moderate
Time-limited exceptions; none for requirements that cannot be on a CMMC POA&M
No SPRS score or affirmation without a current documented assessment; correct within 30 days
CUI only in the enclave and FIL; new prime programs onboarded first
FedRAMP Moderate or equivalent for CUI; FAR terms for FCI; Tier 1 provider reviews
Annual independent assessment and annual SP 800-171 and FAR self-assessment
Approved C-SCRM plan per SP 800-161 Rev. 1
Authorized sources first; current broker approvals; no broker stock on DoD jobs without approval and notice
Manufacturer of record for every SKU; Section 889 and FASCSA blocks including drop-ship; logged SAM.gov searches
Counterfeit detection and avoidance system meeting the 12 DFARS 252.246-7007(c) criteria
Supplier notice terms and flowdown of supply chain clauses
AI tools approved through the P10 process before use
Unique accounts; documented exception for DC automation operator accounts
Enclave access needs screening, U.S. person confirmation, CUI training, and approval per program
MFA for all; phishing-resistant keys for administrators and enclave users
Privileged access through the access broker, including ERP, WMS, and enclave administrators
Quarterly access reviews for ERP, WMS, enclave, and privileged accounts
Same-day removal for leavers including enclave and badges; transfers within 5 business days
Automatic disable after 45 days of inactivity
Remote access through the IdP with MFA; CUI only in enclave virtual desktops
Vendor and integrator access through the gateway; always-on remote tools prohibited
Reseller portal MFA from 2027-01-31
Default passwords changed; service account secrets vaulted and rotated
Report incidents, suspect products, and stray CUI within 1 hour
Track incidents with discovery and identification times
Quarantine suspect counterfeit, tampered, or covered items; no return to the supply chain
Meet DIBNet 72-hour, Section 889 1-business-day, and Kaspersky and FASCSA 3-business-day clocks
Two DIBNet medium assurance certificate holders at all times
Preserve images and monitoring data 90 days after a DIBNet report; malware to DC3
Annual tabletop per runbook with a DIBNet drill
Lessons learned within 30 days into P01 and P07
CUI never in the ERP, corporate email, corporate files, prints outside the FIL, or AI tools
FIPS-validated encryption for CUI in transit and at rest
CUI paper and media marked, locked in the FIL, shredded in the FIL
Removable storage blocked except issued encrypted drives
FCI only to providers with FAR 52.204-21 terms; feeds filtered
Sanitize media with certificates
Isolated, write-once, encrypted backups restore-tested quarterly
Annual awareness with insider threat; role-based and anti-counterfeit training
Call-back verification of bank-detail changes recorded in the ticket
Approved AI tools only; no CUI or FCI in AI tools
Alternate work site rules; CUI only in VDI
Escort visitors; driver check-in; FIL and Integration Center visitor rules
Sanctions documented by HR
